title: [elegance] SmtpRelayQueue two-file format creates orphan-recovery burden
description: The .env + .msg split requires separate atomic renames, creating a window where orphaned .msg files can exist. The drain loop must handle this as dead code (lines 196-199 in relay_queue.rs). A single-file format (e.g. JSON with base64-encoded bytes) would eliminate this coupling risk and the recovery logic burden.
